result:
The configured value started taking effect in PR #1920 (merge commit `4cc27d38`, ticket O3-6028). That PR passes `chooseLocation.locationsPerRequest` into the shared `LocationPicker`, and it removes the unused `numberToShow` option.

The line that passes the value to the picker is `location-picker-view.component.tsx:181`, where `locationsPerRequest={Math.max(chooseLocation.locationsPerRequest, 1)}` is set. Before this change, the picker fell back to its default of 50 (`location-picker.component.tsx:27`), so the configured value was never read.

Supporting evidence:
- The PR body says the login app declared `locationsPerRequest` and `numberToShow` in its schema, but neither was read anywhere. The picker always used its default page size of 50. The PR also deletes the unused `useLoginLocations` hook from `login.resource.ts`.
- `location-picker.component.tsx:27` and `:42` show the default of 50 and its use in `useLocations`. Line 68 uses the same value for the infinite-scroll trigger.
- `location-picker.test.tsx:435-457` adds tests that `locationsPerRequest` reaches the picker, and that a value of 0 falls back to 1.
- `.changeset/login-locations-per-request.md` is the changeset entry for the fix.
- `config-schema.ts:44` and `:166` define the option; the PR removes the `numberToShow` schema entry (7 lines).
